audit_finding_platform_project_null.name: audit_finding_platform_project_null
audit_finding_platform_project_null.value: "audit_finding"."org_id" IS NOT NULL OR "audit_finding"."project_id" IS NULL

sheet_version_status_n_check.name: sheet_version_status_n_check
sheet_version_status_n_check.value: ("sheet_version"."status" = 'draft' AND "sheet_version"."n" IS NULL) OR ("sheet_version"."status" = 'published' AND "sheet_version"."n" IS NOT NULL AND "sheet_version"."n" > 0)

notice_scope_check.name: notice_scope_check
notice_scope_check.value: ("notice"."kind" = 'export_ready' AND "notice"."project_id" IS NULL AND "notice"."call_id" IS NULL AND "notice"."subscriber_id" IS NULL AND "notice"."account_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("notice"."kind" <> 'export_ready' AND "notice"."org_id" IS NOT NULL AND "notice"."project_id" IS NOT NULL)

evidence_request_times.name: evidence_request_times
evidence_request_times.value: "evidence_request"."drafted_at" >= "evidence_request"."received_at" AND "evidence_request"."approved_at" >= "evidence_request"."drafted_at" AND "evidence_request"."replied_at" >= "evidence_request"."received_at" AND "evidence_request"."replied_at" >= "evidence_request"."drafted_at" AND "evidence_request"."replied_at" >= "evidence_request"."approved_at" AND ("evidence_request"."approved_at" IS NULL OR "evidence_request"."drafted_at" IS NOT NULL) AND ("evidence_request"."replied_at" IS NULL OR "evidence_request"."drafted_at" IS NOT NULL)

grade_call_or_night.name: grade_call_or_night
grade_call_or_night.value: num_nonnulls("grade"."call_id", "grade"."night_id") = 1 OR ("grade"."call_id" IS NULL AND "grade"."night_id" IS NULL AND "grade"."window_id" IS NOT NULL)

export_job_active_account_key.name: export_job_active_account_key
export_job_active_account_key.where: "export_job"."scope" = 'account' AND "export_job"."account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "export_job"."status" IN ('queued', 'running')

export_job_active_organisation_key.name: export_job_active_organisation_key
export_job_active_organisation_key.where: "export_job"."scope" = 'organisation' AND "export_job"."org_id" IS NOT NULL AND "export_job"."status" IN ('queued', 'running')

export_job_object_path_under_scope.name: export_job_object_path_under_scope
export_job_object_path_under_scope.value: "export_job"."object_path" IS NULL OR ("export_job"."scope" = 'organisation' AND "export_job"."org_id" IS NOT NULL AND "export_job"."object_path" LIKE 'orgs/' || "export_job"."org_id" || '/exports/%') OR ("export_job"."scope" = 'account' AND "export_job"."account_id" IS NOT NULL AND "export_job"."object_path" LIKE 'accounts/' || "export_job"."account_id" || '/exports/%')
